'''Katharine''' (Japanese: '''コハル''' ''Koharu'') is a recurring character in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]''.

==History==
Katharine debuted in ''[[BW055|Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!]]''. She met up with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} on her way to [[Nimbasa City]] where she planned to obtain her third Badge. Her {{p|Gothita}} took a liking to [[Ash's Scraggy]], and wanted her to [[trade]] one of her own Pokémon to Ash for him. Of course, Ash refused the trade, but Katharine suggested they have a battle, and if she won, she would get to trade with him. Again, Ash was not interested in trading Scraggy. Finally, she resorted to taunting him until he eventually agreed. He was able to knock out her {{p|Mandibuzz}} with his {{AP|Tepig}} before they had to take shelter from a freak rainstorm.

Katharine spent the night with the group in a cabin when they were all awakened by {{AP|Pikachu}}, who informed them that Scraggy, {{TP|Iris|Axew}}, {{AP|Snivy}}, and Gothita were missing. She was in a state of panic afterwards, worrying that something bad would happen to her Gothita. With the help of her {{p|Deerling}}, she was able to help calm a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Garbodor}} to stop it from attacking her Gothita and the other Pokémon.

The next day, she battled Ash again. This time, she used her Gothita while he used his Snivy. The battle ended in a loss for Katharine, and she was forced to run after her Gothita, who left the scene in a fit over the loss.

In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Katharine competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', she appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, indicating that she had made it through the first round. In ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', she appeared once again on the screen of the Vertress Conference, now showing the match-ups for the last sixteen, indicating that she had made it through the second and third rounds. In ''[[BW106|Strong Strategy Steals the Show!]]'', it was revealed that Katharine had made it through the fourth round as well. In the quarterfinals, she battled [[Dino]] and lost to him in ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'', placing her in the Top 8. Afterwards, she appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference.

|desc={{p|Gothita}} is Katharine's main Pokémon and was seen [[Walking Pokémon|outside of her Poké Ball]]. Gothita developed feelings for [[Ash's Scraggy]]. She was shown to be a rather spoiled Pokémon that seems to be able to manipulate her Trainer into doing what she wants. She even seemed to be telling Katharine what attacks {{p|Mandibuzz}} should use during her battle with {{AP|Tepig}}. In the middle of the night, Gothita got Scraggy to run away with her. {{TP|Iris|Axew}} followed them into the forest, where the two began fighting over Scraggy by tugging on his arms. The two started battling shortly after that, and Axew's {{m|Dragon Rage}} sent her flying and landing on top of a sleeping {{p|Garbodor}}. Gothita did not like how it smelled, and attacked it with Double Slap, which angered it. 

Gothita later became angry with [[Ash's Snivy]] after Snivy slapped her on the rear to get her to stop attacking Garbodor. The next day, she wanted to face Snivy in battle. She was quickly defeated, and threw a temper tantrum before leaving the scene.

During the [[Vertress Conference]], Gothita was not shown out of her [[Poké Ball]].

According to Katharine, Gothita is a big fan of [[Elesa]].

Gothita's known moves are {{m|Psychic}}, {{m|Psyshock}}, {{m|Double Slap}}, and {{m|Hidden Power}}.}}
